title: Provision a new VM and prove it with check-vm.sh
caption: docs/mvp/deployment-single-vm.md §3; deploy/scripts/provision-vm.sh and check-vm.sh. Allow one to two hours. Agents never do these steps.

steps.title: Create the VM and DNS
steps.body: Ubuntu 24.04, 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 160 GB, admin user with your key (not root). A/AAAA records for `platform.example.com`, `admin.`, `api.` of it, `admin.ota.example.com`, `api.ota.example.com`, `*.ota.example.com`.

steps.title: Deploy key and Caddy build
steps.body: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f velexis-deploy -C github-actions`; take `caddy/bin/caddy` of the commit's Deploy artefact or `bash deploy/caddy/build/build-caddy.sh /tmp/caddy-build`.
steps.expect: SHA-256 of the binary equals `CADDY_SHA256` in `deploy/caddy/build/versions.env`.

steps.title: Copy and provision
steps.body: `scp -r deploy/ velexis-deploy.pub caddy ubuntu@<vm>:/tmp/` then `sudo DEPLOY_SSH_PUBKEY_FILE=/tmp/velexis-deploy.pub ADMIN_USER=ubuntu CADDY_BINARY=/tmp/caddy bash /tmp/deploy/scripts/provision-vm.sh`.
steps.expect: Steps packages → summary complete; `/var/log/velexis/provision.log` lists them; one-time AIDE re-baseline at the end.

steps.title: SSH second factor
steps.body: Enrol FIDO2 keys (runbooks/ssh-access.md §2) or TOTP (§3), then `sudo ADMIN_USER=ubuntu ADMIN_MFA=fido2 bash /tmp/deploy/scripts/provision-vm.sh --steps ssh`. Keep a session open.
steps.expect: From a second terminal a plain key is refused and the security key logs in.

steps.title: Fill the env files
steps.body: Replace every `CHANGE_ME` and placeholder host in `/etc/velexis/*.env` and `caddy.env` (`PLATFORM_BASE_DOMAIN`, `STOREFRONT_BASE_DOMAIN`, `ACME_EMAIL`); `sudo systemctl restart caddy`.
steps.expect: `https://platform.<domain>/` serves the maintenance page with a valid certificate.

steps.title: Backups and logs
steps.body: age public keys in `/etc/velexis/backup/*-recipients.txt`, `rclone.conf`, `RCLONE_REMOTE`; `sudo systemctl start velexis-backup`, `sudo systemctl start velexis-ship-logs && sudo velexis-shiplogs --status`.
steps.expect: The five `.age` files and `MANIFEST.txt` under `daily/<date>/`; a delete of a canary object fails with AccessDenied.

steps.title: Check everything
steps.expect: Every line `PASS`, exit 0. No value is printed.

steps.title: Back up /etc/velexis offline
steps.body: Encrypted copy to your password manager: it holds the master key.
steps.expect: You can restore the master key without the VM.
